backtest.method: walk-forward, ESPN spread as the market line, FBS vs FBS regular season

table.label: Every game the model projected
table.note: The baseline: the model's side in every finished game, picks and leans, whatever Sharp Money did.

table.label: Sharp Money is on the same side as the model
table.note: A line-move, sharp-account, money or books-behind card showed on the model's team and none on the other team.

table.label: Sharp Money is on the other side
table.note: Cards showed only on the team the model is against.

table.label: Sharp Money is on both sides
table.note: Cards showed on both teams, so the signals disagree.

table.label: The line moved toward the model's team
table.note: The Pinnacle number shortened for the model's side before kickoff.

table.label: The line moved away from the model's team
table.note: The Pinnacle number moved toward the other team.

table.label: Sharp accounts bet the model's team
table.note: Accounts with a proven record put real money on the model's side.

table.label: Sharp accounts bet the other team
table.note: Those accounts went the other way.

table.label: Bigger money than bets on the model's team
table.note: A larger share of the dollars than of the tickets, which points to larger bettors.

table.label: Two or more signals back the model
table.note: More than one kind of card on the model's team.

table.label: Model picks (5+ points) that Sharp Money backs
table.note: The model is 5+ points from the market and a card is on its side.

table.label: Model picks (5+ points) with no Sharp Money behind them
table.note: The model is 5+ points from the market and no card is on its side.

rows.label: Still a pick when locked
rows.note: A first-sight pick that was still 5+ points from the market an hour before kickoff, graded at the locked line.

rows.label: Dropped under 5 points by the lock
rows.note: Logged as a pick, but the gap closed before kickoff. Graded at the first-sight line, as in the official record.

rows.label: Became a pick in the last hour
rows.note: Under 5 points when first seen, 5+ at the lock.

rows.label: Locked picks with Sharp Money on their side
rows.note: At the lock the model is 5+ points off and a card is on its team and none on the other.

rows.label: Locked picks with Sharp Money against them
rows.note: Cards only on the other team.

rows.label: Locked picks, Sharp Money split or quiet
rows.note: Cards on both teams, or no card at all.

open_check.source: ESPN recorded open (DraftKings), else CollegeFootballData spreadOpen

backtest.note: 5+ point disagreements, weeks 4+, model tuned on 2022-23 only
